Results.ReviewText:
The assembly directions were clear, and the steps were easy to complete - no need to pay for assembly at distributor.
Works like a charm - the ignition system is flawless- what a pleasant feature.
A small but great feature design: the disposable drip tray is accessible from the front of the grill!  
Grilling has worked without a hitch - steaks, grilled veggies (cabbage wedges, Cauliflower, etc.), chicken quarters and breasts, salmon in foil. The cooking guidelines in the manual help me get accustomed to this grill’s cooking times.
Results.Title: This is Not Your Father’s Grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Soooo happy and wished I had purchased sooner. Easy to assemble - don’t rush and the installation will fall into place (took an hour). Easy to start the flame, but more importantly the grill heats up fast. The cast iron grates are the way to go, perfect cross-marks and temperature control. You’ll need to purchase a cover for your grill. Thank you Weber for the 5 star grill

Results.ReviewText: Purchased the Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill cause I was a previous Weber Genesis gas grill owner for many many years.  My house came with a Char Broil Commercial model left in the back yard but it fizzled out after 10 years and replaced with the Spirit.  The Spirit construction is not built like my old Genesis but works just as well or better.  The Spirit seems to have some parts cut back from the Genesis model like the drip tray and just has replaceable foil tray.    Fairly happy so far, we will see if I get all the years out of the Spirit as I did with the Genesis.  I had the Genesis 1000 for almost 21 years.

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
